name: Payroll Area
description: AI-assisted generation of SAP payroll areas based on company profile, frequencies, regions, and unions

payrollAreas.description: Array of payroll area definitions generated by AI or manually configured

description.description: Human-readable payroll area name (e.g. Weekly California)

calendarId.description: SAP calendar ID for period parameters (e.g. 80, 20, 40)

union.description: Union code if applicable (e.g. L11, L39)

employeeCount.description: Number of employees assigned to this area

reasoning.description: Audit trail explaining why this area was created

payDay.description: Day of pay within the period

completion.rule: Zustand persisted store containing payrollAreas array with at least one entry

dataAccess.notes: Data lives inside shared Zustand store 'turbosap-config' under state.payrollAreas. Draft session also stored at turbosap.payroll_area.draft.v1.{userId}
